installer.closeAndRetry: Mordred is still running. Close it, then open the Mordred installer again.
installer.couldNotStop: Mordred could not be stopped. Restart the Mac, then open the Mordred installer again.
installer.done: Mordred is installed and starts when you log in. Its backup file is {path}: that file alone restores your keys on another Mac, so keep a copy somewhere safe and private.
installer.downloadFailed: {name} did not download. Check the network, then open the Mordred installer again: it continues where it stopped.
installer.downloadStarted: Downloading {name} (about {size} MB). The installer keeps going on its own.
installer.fileInTheWay: {path} is in the way and was not made by Mordred. Move it elsewhere, then open the Mordred installer again.
installer.largeModel: Also download the large model (Bonsai 27B, about 8 GB)? It writes headlines and topics for your history. You can add it later by opening the Mordred installer again.
installer.needsTools: Mordred needs Apple's Command Line Tools. Install them in the window that just opened, then open the Mordred installer again.
installer.serverDidNotStop: Mordred's server did not stop. Wait a minute, then open the Mordred installer again.
installer.stillRunning: Mordred is still running (an earlier install, or a Hermes window). Stop it and continue?
installer.touchIdNext: Next, confirm with Touch ID: once now to set up Mordred's keys, and once more in a moment when Mordred starts. Press OK, then touch the sensor when the Touch ID window appears.
installer.touchIdNotConfirmed: Touch ID was not confirmed, so the keys were not set up. Open the Mordred installer again.
installer.touchIdRetry: Touch ID was not confirmed, so nothing was set up yet. Try again?
installer.unexpected: A step stopped unexpectedly (line {line}). Open the log to see which; then open the Mordred installer again: it continues where it stopped.
installer.unfinishedKeys: The keys of an earlier, unfinished setup could not be removed. Open the Mordred installer again.

touchId.approveBrowser: Allow the browser “{label}” to connect to Mordred. Code {code}
touchId.credentials: Read Mordred's Telegram or mail sign-in
touchId.setup: Set up Mordred's keys and encryption
